questions.question: Which of the following natural resources does the use of advanced batteries and Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) manufacturing help reduce dependence on?
The Mauryas came into power after defeating the ruler of which of the following dynasties?
Which technology allows farmers to apply fertilisers, water or pesticides at different rates across a field based on soil and crop needs?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Variable rate technology) है।

questions.question: Which organisation, in February 2025, urged the government to take immediate action to curb obscene content on OTT platforms and social media streaming sites?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (National Commission for Women) है।

questions.question: Who is the author of the book 'The Palace of Illusions: A Novel'?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni) है।

questions.question: Which of the following markets primarily deals with short-term debt securities?
Which former Indian hockey goalkeeper was honoured with a Padma Award in 2025?
Who among the following is widely considered as the Father of Telugu Cinema?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Raghupathi Venkaiah Naidu) है।

questions.question: Which telecom company bid the highest amount in 5G Spectrum auction held in June 2024?
On 16 May 2024, the Supreme Court of India (SCI) limited the power of Enforcement Department (ED) under which Act?
options: Conservation of Foreign Exchange and Prevention of Smuggling Activities Act
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA)) है।

questions.question: The fresh election to constitute a Panchayat shall be completed before the expiry of its duration of _____ or in case of dissolution, before the expiry of 6 months from the date of its dissolution.
The first 3D movie of India, 'My Dear Kuttichathan', was originally made in which language?
What is the primary goal of the Viksit Bharat 2047 initiative?
options: To achieve a fully digital India by 2047
To make India a developed country by 2047
To make India the largest economy by 2047
To make India self-sufficient in renewable energy by 2047
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To make India a developed country by 2047) है।

questions.question: Savalda Chalcolithic culture is found in which State?
Sanamahism is a noticeable phenomenon in the religious picture of the Indian State of _______.
Which state topped the Khelo India Beach Games 2025 medal tally with 14 total medals?
Which of the following is often referred to as liquidity preference?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Demand for money) है।
